messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Calculate R2 using qtl package in R
parts:
The only function that provides an estimate of proportion of phenotypic variance explained is fitqtl(). You need to first call makeqtl() with the position of interest and then fitqtl() and summary().

You can also use the equation relating LOD and sample size to heritability. See pg 77 in chapter 4 of the R/qtl book, available as one of the online sample chapters: https://rqtl.org/book/rqtlbook_ch04.pdf

karl
